records.jp: 日菜子、今時間とれないかしら？
records.en_original: Hinako, are you free right now?
records.en_auxiliary: Hinako, do you have a minute?
records.en: Hinako, are you free right now?

records.jp: トレーニングの成果が出てきたと思うから、見てほしくって
records.en_original: I think my training's starting to show results, so I wanted you to take a look.
records.en_auxiliary: I think my training's starting to show results, so I wondered if you could take a look.
records.en: I think my training's starting to show results, so I wanted you to take a look.

records.jp: いいよ
records.en_original: Sure.
records.en_auxiliary: Absolutely.
records.en: Sure.

records.jp: ありがとう。じゃあ屋上に行きましょう
records.en_original: Thanks. Let's go to the rooftop.
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks. Let's go to the rooftop.
records.en: Thanks. Let's go to the rooftop.

records.jp: うん。確かにだいぶよくなったね
records.en_original: Yeah, you've gotten a lot better.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, you've really improved.
records.en: Yeah, you've gotten a lot better.

records.jp: ええ。実際にやってみたらすごく効果があったわ
records.en_original: I thought so! I put a lot of work into what you showed me, and it lead to some really amazing results.
records.en_auxiliary: I thought so! I put a lot of work into what you showed me, and it lead to some really amazing results.
records.en: Yes. Once I actually tried it, it was very effective.

records.jp: ライム、この間との違いわかった？
records.en_original: Lime, did you notice a difference from before?
records.en_auxiliary: Lime, did you notice a change from before?
records.en: Lime, did you notice a difference from before?

records.jp: よくなったとはわかるけど……たぶん素人にはわからないくらい<CR>細かい違いなんじゃないかしら
records.en_original: I could see that she was better, but...the exact differences are too subtle for an amateur like me to spot.
records.en_auxiliary: Her performance looked better, but I'm not experienced enough to say exactly why.
records.en: I can tell it improved, but... I think the differences are probably<CR>too subtle for an amateur to notice.

records.jp: だよねー。二人ともすごいなー
records.en_original: Same. Sara and Hina are really amazing, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Me too. Sara and Hina are really amazing, aren't they?
records.en: Right? You two are amazing.

records.jp: ……まだまだみたいね
records.en_original: ...I've still got a long way to go, though.
records.en_auxiliary: ...I've still got a long way to go, though.
records.en: ...I've still got a long way to go, though.

records.jp: さすがにすぐには難しいよ。あまり急にやりすぎても<CR>体に負担が来るし、無理しすぎないようにね
records.en_original: You can't improve overnight. If you push yourself too suddenly, it'll strain your body. Don't overdo it.
records.en_auxiliary: Rome wasn't built in a day. If you push yourself too much too quick, it'll strain your body. Don't overdo it.
records.en: You can't improve overnight.<CR>If you push yourself too hard all at once, it'll strain your body, so don't overdo it.

records.jp: 日菜子……ええ、わかったわ
records.en_original: I know, you're right...
records.en_auxiliary: Of course, you're right.
records.en: Hinako... Yes, I understand.

records.jp: けど、もうひとつ聞きたいことがあるから見てくれない？<CR>このステップの部分だけど
records.en_original: But there's something else I wanted to ask you about. Would you mind? It's this step...
records.en_auxiliary: But there's something else I wanted to ask you about. Would you mind? It's this step...
records.en: But there's one more thing I want to ask about. Would you take a look?<CR>It's this step here.

records.jp: （更紗……本当に楽しそうに踊るな……）
records.en_original: (Sarasa really does love dancing...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Sarasa really does love dancing.)
records.en: (Sarasa... really looks like she's having fun dancing...)

records.jp: 痛っ！
records.en_original: Ow!
records.en_auxiliary: Ow!
records.en: Ow!

records.jp: ちょっ、日菜子！
records.en_original: Hinako!?
records.en_auxiliary: Hinako?!
records.en: W-Wait, Hinako!

records.jp: 大丈夫！？
records.en_original: Are you okay!?
records.en_auxiliary: Are you okay?!
records.en: Are you okay!?

records.jp: う、うん……
records.en_original: Y-yeah...
records.en_auxiliary: Y-yeah...
records.en: Y-yeah...

records.jp: 急に踊り始めちゃったからビックリしたよ
records.en_original: You started dancing all of a sudden. It really surprised me!
records.en_auxiliary: That was a shock! You started dancing out of nowhere.
records.en: You started dancing all of a sudden. It really surprised me!

records.jp: ご、ごめん……つい……。<CR>あーあ、早く私も踊りたいなー……
records.en_original: S-Sorry. It was just instinct... Ugh, I want to be able to dance again soon...
records.en_auxiliary: S-sorry. It was instinct. Ugh, I want to be able to dance again soon.
records.en: S-Sorry... I just couldn't help it.<CR>Ahh, I want to dance again soon...

records.jp: 日菜子……ごめんなさい……
records.en_original: Hinako... I'm sorry...
records.en_auxiliary: Hinako... I'm sorry.
records.en: Hinako... I'm sorry...

records.jp: え？　なんで更紗が謝るの？
records.en_original: Huh? Why are you apologizing?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Why are you apologizing?
records.en: Huh? Why are you apologizing?

records.jp: 私がバレエの相談をしなきゃ、<CR>日菜子に余計な感情を抱かせなくて済んだから……
records.en_original: If I didn't ask you about ballet, you wouldn't have it occupying your mind like this.
records.en_auxiliary: If I didn't ask you to help me, you wouldn't be obsessing about ballet like this.
records.en: If I hadn't asked you about ballet,<CR>I wouldn't have stirred up unnecessary feelings in you...

records.jp: 私、日菜子にはずっとバレエのことを考えててほしくて
records.en_original: But, to be honest, I did want to keep you thinking about ballet.
records.en_auxiliary: But, to be honest, I did want you to keep thinking about it.
records.en: I wanted you to keep thinking about ballet.

records.jp: それで、相談を？
records.en_original: So that's why you asked me for help?
records.en_auxiliary: So that's why you asked me for help?
records.en: So that's why you asked me for help?

records.jp: ホントに悩んでたことだったけどね
records.en_original: Well, I really was having some trouble...
records.en_auxiliary: Well, I really was having some trouble.
records.en: Well, I really was having some trouble...

records.jp: そんな気の遣い方しないで。<CR>私は私のペースでやるから大丈夫
records.en_original: Don't worry about it so much. I'll be fine as long as I go at my own pace.
records.en_auxiliary: Don't worry about it so much. I'll be fine as long as I go at my own pace.
records.en: You don't need to worry about me like that.<CR>I'll go at my own pace, so I'm fine.

records.jp: ……ごめんなさい
records.en_original: Still, I'm sorry...
records.en_auxiliary: Still, I'm sorry.
records.en: Still, I'm sorry...

records.jp: さっ。この話はこれでおしまい。<CR>もう少し練習の続きをしよう
records.en_original: Come on, that's enough of this subject. Let's practice a little more.
records.en_auxiliary: Come on, that's enough of this subject. Let's practice a little more.
records.en: Come on, that's enough of that.<CR>Let's practice a little more.

records.jp: ええ
records.en_original: Okay...
records.en_auxiliary: Okay.
records.en: Okay...

records.jp: ……余計なお世話だよ
records.en_original: ...My dancing is none of your concern.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't want you to make MY dancing YOUR problem.
records.en: That was none of your business.

records.jp: わかってる。でも、私も不安なの……
records.en_original: I know. But I'm worried about myself, too...
records.en_auxiliary: I know. But I'm worried about myself, too.
records.en: I know. But I'm worried too...

records.jp: 日菜子がいない中で、自分がバレエを続けていけるのか……
records.en_original: I don't know if I can keep going with ballet if you're not around...
records.en_auxiliary: I don't know if I can keep going with ballet without you around.
records.en: About whether I can keep going with ballet without you, Hinako...

records.jp: 更紗……
records.en_original: Sarasa...
records.en_auxiliary: Sarasa...
records.en: Sarasa...

records.jp: ごめんなさい、変な話をしちゃって。<CR>さっ。もう少し練習に付き合ってよね
records.en_original: Sorry, that sounded kind of weird, huh? Anyway, could you help me practice a little more?
records.en_auxiliary: Sorry, that sounded kind of weird, didn't it? Anyway, could you help me practice a little more?
records.en: Sorry for saying something strange.<CR>Come on, keep practicing with me a little longer.

records.jp: う、うん……
records.en_original: S-Sure...
records.en_auxiliary: Y-yeah...
records.en: S-Sure...

records.jp: 更紗――
records.en_original: Sarasa...
records.en_auxiliary: Sarasa...
records.en: Sarasa...

records.jp: （何と返答しよう？）
records.en_original: (How should I reply?)
records.en_auxiliary: (How should I reply?)
records.en: (How should I reply?)
